title: Al Jazeera Learning Arabic — Immersion Course
position_in_path: after the English-supported beginner foundation course

activation_gate.checkpoint_goal: Learner can follow simple fully-Arabic instructions/dialogues without needing constant English translation and can handle basic A1 grammar/vocabulary productively.

reason_deferred: The current Al Jazeera materials are too strict an Arabic-only approach for the active beginner phase, and some previously saved media links were missing/unavailable. Use it later as an immersion transition rather than as the introductory spine.

media_policy.on_activation: Re-search and verify every individual Al Jazeera media item before presenting it. Do not assume previously stored video/audio is still present.
media_policy.fallback: If Al Jazeera media remains unavailable at activation, replace that lesson with another Arabic-first graded MSA source while preserving the immersion-course role.

planned_concept_clusters: greetings and introductions in Arabic-only context
name, nationality, profession, and personal information
longer multi-speaker listening and media-language transition
spaced_reinforcement_role: Re-present beginner concepts through Arabic-only input after they are already familiar, creating desirable difficulty and transfer rather than first exposure.
